README and subject.mjs reads were masked (observation_masked), so I don't have their content. But I have the subject.mjs source from the envelope with sha 6ae4992... which matches mutation_files. The README masked content — requirements are in contract.json which I have. The masked README/subject reads... instructions say "After recycling, required archive recovery uses read-inspection-evidence" — but I don't have that tool. I'll proceed with patch based on contract and source.

Current subject.mjs bug check vs contract:
- Offsets count UTF-16 units — yes.
- Never begin/end inside surrogate pair: it doesn't reject interior start! Contract says "reject an interior start". Current code only adjusts end. Need: if offset is interior of a pair (splitPair(offset)), throw 'inspection-range-splits-unicode'? Actually the error codes are ours to choose; must preserve API. Contract: reject interior start, move interior end backward. Also "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair."

Current code: end adjusted back if split pair at end. need(end>offset||offset===text.length). Interior start: if splitPair(offset), throw. That's missing. Also "cannot make progress" — if end moved back equals offset, then end>offset fails → already rejected. So only missing: reject interior start.

Write replacement: add
if(splitPair(offset))throw new Error('inspection-range-splits-unicode');

Keep all else identical.
